Why Coolidge?
The only modern president who translated Dante from the Italian for amusement, Coolidge prized undergraduate education and believed it established men and women for life. “No question can be adequately comprehended without knowing its historical background,” Coolidge wrote. Mrs. Coolidge, the first professional first lady, graduated from the University of Vermont and also prized education.
What is the Calvin Coolidge Presidential Foundation and Calvin Coolidge Presidential Fund?
The Coolidge Scholarship is a program of the Calvin Coolidge Presidential Fund, a supporting organization of the
Calvin Coolidge Presidential Foundation
. Both the Coolidge Fund and the Coolidge Foundation are 501(c)(3) nonprofit educational organizations.

How old is the Coolidge Scholars Program?
The Coolidge Scholars Program launched in the winter of 2016 and the inaugural class was formally inducted in July 2016. The 2026-27 application cycle will mark the twelfth year of the Coolidge Scholarship.
How many Coolidge Scholars are selected each year?
The number of new Coolidge Scholarships is determined annually. To view recent classes of Coolidge Scholars, please click
here
.
